assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All geometry layers use the official provisional boundaries (official_boundary=false). They are concept references, not redlines, approval basis, or precise area basis.
assumptions.impact: Once official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are released, site boundary, key areas, land use, roads, green space, public space, buildings, phasing, and all metrics must be recomputed; this proposal states conclusions as replaceable/recomputable.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap data within the design bbox (© OSM contributors, ODbL) is used as base map only; completeness and currency vary by area and editor activity.
assumptions.impact: Building counts (489 across three key areas), road classes, and station positions are indicative baselines for concept design, not authoritative survey results; professional survey data must replace them for statutory use.

assumptions.statement: Design target metrics (station 800m coverage ≥0.60, green 500m residential coverage baseline 0.60 → target 0.75, slow corridor density, AI signal nodes ≥30) are concept-level targets derived from the submitted layers and OSM base data.
assumptions.impact: They are design goals for discussion and deepening, not approved statutory indicators; the 0.75 green-coverage target is an improvement direction pending detailed park network design.

assumptions.statement: All global AI innovation activities, annual event system, branding, scenario operations, and public experience routes are concept suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: They must not be read as confirmed government events, funding arrangements, or implementation commitments.
